problem: The jam signal length is stated as 32 bytes, but the Ethernet standard defines the jam signal as 32 bits (4 bytes).
fix: Change the text to: "If collision detected, transmit a jam signal for 32 bits (4 bytes)."

problem: Maximum pure ALOHA throughput is given as "frames/slot", but pure ALOHA has no slots; the unit should be frames per frame time.
fix: Replace "frames/slot" with "frames per frame time" for the pure ALOHA throughput value.

problem: The statement "CW starts at 15 and doubles after each failure" is slightly inaccurate; after the first failure CW becomes 31, not exactly double of 15.
fix: Modify to: "CW starts at CW_min = 15. After each failure the contention window is updated using CW = 2^i·(CW_min+1)‑1, which yields 31 after the first failure, 63 after the second, etc."

problem: The description "Ethernet slot time = 512 bits (64 bytes) at 10 Mbps" may suggest the slot time depends on speed, while the slot time is defined as 512 bits regardless of link rate.
fix: Clarify: "Ethernet slot time is defined as the time to transmit 512 bits (64 bytes). At 10 Mbps this equals 51.2 µs; at higher speeds the time scales accordingly."
